I replied to Ilse in our DM. I confirmed their new 7 July cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork and said it stays between us.

I took no other action, since they said none was needed. I didn't save the date to GBrain because it's shared across the team and other people can read it, so this DM is the only place it's recorded. I searched GBrain first and found nothing there about this cutoff. That search ran in keyword-only mode, so it may have missed notes worded differently.
